full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that. opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 as pre-emptors filed a case land under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Gobindaganj being Miscellaneous Case No. 64 of 1984, alleging, inter alia, that they are co-sharers to the case jote by inheritance while the pre-emptees are strangers thereto. Opposite party No. 4 Naheruddin sold the case land measuring 0.51 decimals to opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 by kabala dated 30-7-76 at a consideration of Taka 5000.00 without serving any notice, upon them as required by law. On obtaining the certified copy of the impugned Kabala the pre-emptors filed the pre-emption case on 15-3-79 after making the statutory deposit. It is to be noted in this connection that the registration of the impugned kabala under section 60 of the Registration Act was completed on 2-12-76.
